# Forwarded email -- 2026-05-02

Fictional fixture for the requirements-translator agent. Names and systems are illustrative.

From: client lead
To: advisor
Subject: Connecting our CRM to the ERP -- need a recommendation

---

Hi,

We have HubSpot for sales and NetSuite for finance and they don't talk to each other today. Sales reps enter a deal in HubSpot, then someone in finance manually re-keys it into NetSuite once the deal closes. We lose roughly two business days every week to this and we're starting to see typos that cause invoicing errors.

We need an integration. I have heard names like Boomi, Workato, Celigo, MuleSoft. I do not have a strong opinion. The CFO wants something that does not require us to add another full-time hire just to babysit it.

A few things I cannot answer myself:
- We do have some custom fields in HubSpot. Whatever the solution is, it needs to handle those.
- We are growing fast so the volume will be higher next year than today.
- I think we need this live before our fiscal year-end audit in February.

Can you put together a recommendation? Happy to set up a call.

Thanks
